Its global squared-distortion variance, direction-independent quartic tensor with exact constant, complete sixth tensor and first demonstrable order of anisotropy are natural higher-order risk/error invariants, not supplied by the known quadratic optimum. The entire low-order tensor classification, rather than a single arbitrary entry, yields a motivated and reproducible geometric benchmark.
